summary.en: Thursday's ECB fix came in at 6.1355 (−0.36%) — but only because the euro slipped. After the fix, sentiment turned: the Nasdaq plunged 5.5%, and the dollar closed in São Paulo at R$ 5.4876.

summary.de: Jetzt sind sich die Wetterseiten einig: Bis Sonntag kommt immer wieder Regen. Gestern sah eine Quelle den Freitag noch trocken, heute sehen alle Schauer.
summary.en: Now the weather sites agree: rain keeps coming back through Sunday. Yesterday one source still had Friday dry; today all of them show showers.
summary.pt: Agora os sites de previsão concordam: até domingo vai chover de vez em quando. Ontem uma fonte ainda via a sexta-feira seca; hoje todas veem pancadas.
summary.es: Ahora las páginas del clima coinciden: hasta el domingo habrá lluvia una y otra vez. Ayer una fuente todavía veía el viernes seco; hoy todas ven chubascos.
